example_uz: Sher va yo‘lbarsning duragayi bo‘lgan tion juda kam uchraydi.

definition_en: To remove dirt or dust from a surface using a cloth.
example_en: You should dust the furniture before you start cleaning the floor.
example_uz: Polni tozalashdan oldin mebelning changini artib olishing kerak.

definition_en: Happening at a certain time in the future from now.
example_en: The meeting will take place two weeks hence in the main office.
example_uz: Uchrashuv ikki haftadan so‘ng markaziy idorada bo‘lib o‘tadi.

definition_en: In every way or completely.
example_en: I am not entirely sure if we have enough time for this.
example_uz: Bunga yetarli vaqtimiz borligiga unchalik ishonchim komil emas.

definition_en: A system that uses radio waves to find the position and speed of objects.
example_en: The airport uses radar to track the positions of all incoming planes.
example_uz: Aeroport barcha kelayotgan samolyotlar o'rnini kuzatish uchun radardan foydalanadi.

definition_en: To save someone or something from a dangerous situation.
example_en: The well-trained team rescued everyone after the avalanche in the mountains.
example_uz: Tog'dagi qor ko'chkidan so'ng yaxshi tayyorgarlik ko'rgan guruh barchani qutqarib qoldi.

definition_en: To try to stop something bad from happening or spreading.
example_en: The government is trying to find new ways to combat drug addiction.
example_uz: Hukumat giyohvandlikka qarshi kurashishning yangi usullarini izlamoqda.

definition_en: Not moving anymore, or having come to an end.
example_en: They passed a stopped car on the side of the road today.
example_uz: Ular bugun yo'l chetida to'xtab turgan mashina yonidan o'tib ketishdi.

definition_en: A person's job or the regular work they do to earn money.
example_en: Please fill out your name, address, and occupation on this form.
example_uz: Iltimos, ushbu shaklga ismingiz, manzilingiz va kasbingizni yozing.

definition_en: Money or goods given to help people or organizations in need.
example_en: The charity relies on small donations from the public to survive.
example_uz: Xayriya tashkiloti o'z faoliyatini yuritish uchun aholidan tushadigan kichik ehsonlarga tayanadi.

definition_en: A person who professionally makes and sells bread and other baked goods.
example_en: The local baker makes fresh bread every morning before we wake up.
example_uz: Mahalliy novvoy har kuni ertalab biz uyg'onishimizdan oldin yangi non yopadi.

definition_en: In, at, or to a place that is not here.
example_en: If this shop is closed, we should try looking somewhere elsewhere.
example_uz: Agar bu do'kon yopiq bo'lsa, biz boshqa joydan izlab ko'rishimiz kerak.

definition_en: Tending to dislike change or innovation and preferring traditional ways.
example_en: The older generation often has a conservative view on new technology.
example_uz: Keksa avlod vakillari yangi texnologiyalarga nisbatan ko'pincha konservativ qarashadi.

definition_en: A book for guests to write their names and comments in.
example_en: Please write your name in the guestbook before you leave the hotel.
example_uz: Mehmonxonadan chiqib ketishdan oldin ismingizni mehmonlar kitobiga yozib qo'ying.

definition_en: To make someone feel surprised or upset by something bad or unexpected.
example_en: The sudden news about the accident really shocked the whole town.
example_uz: Baxtsiz hodisa haqidagi to'satdan chiqqan xabar butun shaharni larzaga soldi.

definition_en: The quality of being successful in achieving a specific result.
example_en: We need to test the effectiveness of this new teaching method.
example_uz: Biz ushbu yangi o'qitish usulining samaradorligini sinab ko'rishimiz kerak.

definition_en: A very hard, dark, and expensive wood from tropical trees used for expensive furniture.
example_en: The artist carved a beautiful small statue out of dark polished ebony.
example_uz: San'atkor qora rangli ebanoz yog'ochidan kichik haykalcha o'ydi.

definition_en: Used to describe a game or competition that finished with no winner or loser.
example_en: The final football match ended in a tense and drawn game today.
example_uz: Bugungi futbol finali keskin va durang natija bilan yakunlandi.

definition_en: A person who goes for a walk, especially for exercise or for pleasure.
example_en: The park was full of early morning walkers enjoying the fresh air.
example_uz: Bog' erta tongda toza havodan bahra olayotgan piyodalar bilan to'la edi.

definition_en: To touch someone with your lips to show love, affection, or as a greeting.
example_en: She leaned forward to kiss her mother on the cheek goodbye.
example_uz: U xayrlashish uchun onasining yuzidan o'pib qo'ydi.

definition_en: A large or dangerous animal that lives in the wild.
example_en: The legends told stories of a dangerous beast living in the forest.
example_uz: Afsonalarda o'rmonda yashaydigan xavfli yirtqich haqida hikoyalar aytilgan.

definition_en: A scientific test done to learn how something works or if an idea is true.
example_en: We will conduct a science experiment in the lab this afternoon.
example_uz: Bugun tushdan keyin laboratoriyada ilmiy tajriba o'tkazamiz.

definition_en: Coming from or going to another country across the sea.
example_en: Many companies are now expanding into new overseas markets for growth.
example_uz: Ko'plab kompaniyalar hozirda o'sish uchun xorijiy bozorlarga kirib bormoqda.

definition_en: To avoid something by moving quickly or using a clever trick.
example_en: He tried to dodge the difficult question during the live interview.
example_uz: U jonli efirdagi intervyu paytida qiyin savoldan qochishga urindi.

definition_en: To give professional or expert advice to someone about a problem.
example_en: The lawyer did counsel his client to remain silent during questioning.
example_uz: Advokat mijoziga so'roq paytida sukut saqlashni maslahat berdi.

definition_en: A group of states or organizations that are joined together as one.
example_en: The sports federation decided to host the international championship this year.
example_uz: Sport federatsiyasi bu yil xalqaro chempionatni o'tkazishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A round flat piece of bread baked with cheese and vegetables on top.
example_en: We ordered a large pepperoni pizza for our dinner last night.
example_uz: Kecha kechki ovqat uchun katta pepperoni pitszasi buyurtma qildik.

definition_en: A piece of work that someone is given to do.
example_en: The teacher gave us a challenging assignment to complete by Friday.
example_uz: O'qituvchi bizga jumagacha bajarishimiz kerak bo'lgan murakkab vazifa berdi.

definition_en: Questions or requests for information made to someone or a computer system.
example_en: The teacher was happy to answer any queries from the students.
example_uz: O'qituvchi o'quvchilardan kelgan har qanday savollarga javob berishdan xursand bo'ldi.

definition_en: To move or do something very quickly because you do not have much time.
example_en: I had to rush to catch my bus this morning.
example_uz: Bugun ertalab avtobusga ulgurish uchun shoshilishimga to'g'ri keldi.

definition_en: The fact of not being where you are expected to be.
example_en: During his long absence from work, the office was very quiet.
example_uz: Uning ishda uzoq vaqt bo'lmaganida, ofis juda sokin edi.

definition_en: A group of similar things that are positioned or occurring closely together.
example_en: A small cluster of trees stood in the middle of the field.
example_uz: Dala o'rtasida bir to'da daraxtlar o'sib turardi.

definition_en: Used to compare two different facts or situations.
example_en: I love spicy food, whereas my sister prefers it mild.
example_uz: Men achchiq taomlarni yaxshi ko'raman, holbuki singlim shirinroq ovqatlarni afzal ko'radi.

definition_en: A system of physical and mental exercises for health and relaxation.
example_en: She practices yoga every morning to feel relaxed and focused.
example_uz: U o'zini xotirjam va diqqatli his qilish uchun har kuni ertalab yoga bilan shug'ullanadi.

definition_en: The feeling you get when something unexpected happens.
example_en: It was a big surprise when my friend visited me today.
example_uz: Bugun do'stim meni ko'rgani kelganida, bu juda kutilmagan hol bo'ldi.

definition_en: Every person in a group or in the world.
example_en: Does everybody have their ticket ready for the train ride today?
example_uz: Poyezdga chiqish uchun hammaning chiptasi tayyormi?

definition_en: Causing deep admiration and respect due to extreme beauty or magnificence.
example_en: The view of the mountains at sunrise was absolutely sublime and unforgettable.
example_uz: Quyosh chiqayotgandagi tog‘lar manzarasi juda hayratomuz va unutilmas edi.

definition_en: Good enough to be allowed or to satisfy a specific need.
example_en: His performance was acceptable, although it could have been much better.
example_uz: Uning ishi maqbul darajada edi, garchi undan ham yaxshiroq bo‘lishi mumkin bo‘lsa-da.

definition_en: Feeling happy and pleased about something.
example_en: I am so glad that you could come to my party today.
example_uz: Bugun bazmimga kela olganingizdan juda xursandman.

definition_en: The planet Earth, or a round model representing the Earth.
example_en: Students looked at the globe to locate all the different countries.
example_uz: O‘quvchilar barcha mamlakatlarni topish uchun globusga qarashdi.

definition_en: A reddish-brown metal used for making coins, wires, and pipes.
example_en: Old electricity wires are often made of copper because it conducts well.
example_uz: Eski elektr simlari ko‘pincha misdan yasaladi, chunki u tokni yaxshi o‘tkazadi.

definition_en: A structure with shelves or hooks for holding or storing things.
example_en: Please put your wet coat on the rack near the front door.
example_uz: Iltimos, ho'l paltongizni eshik yonidagi ilmoqqa osib qo'ying.

definition_en: A substance or drug used to treat an illness or improve health.
example_en: You must take your medication exactly as the doctor has prescribed it.
example_uz: Siz dorini shifokor aytganidek aynan vaqtida ichishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A large building where goods are stored before they are sold or distributed.
example_en: The furniture is kept in a warehouse until it is ready for delivery.
example_uz: Mebel yetkazib berishga tayyor bo'lguncha omborda saqlanadi.

definition_en: Software that is available to use for free, usually with limited features or time.
example_en: You can download this shareware to test if the program suits your needs.
example_uz: Dastur sizning ehtiyojlaringizga mos kelishini sinab ko'rish uchun ushbu versiyani yuklab oling.

definition_en: A paper document showing that money has been paid for goods or services.
example_en: Keep your receipt in case you need to return the item later.
example_uz: Agar mahsulotni qaytarishingiz kerak bo'lsa, chekingizni saqlab qo'ying.

definition_en: Believed or claimed by many people to be true, although this may not be true.
example_en: He is the supposed leader of this dangerous and secret criminal organization.
example_uz: U ushbu xavfli va maxfiy jinoiy tashkilotning taxminiy yetakchisi hisoblanadi.

definition_en: Not any person; not a single human being.
example_en: I looked inside the dark room, but there was nobody at all.
example_uz: Qorong‘u xonaning ichiga qaradim, lekin u yerda hech kim yo‘q edi.

definition_en: The spirit of a dead person that some people believe can be seen.
example_en: The children were scared because they thought they saw a ghost yesterday.
example_uz: Bolalar qo‘rqib ketishdi, chunki ular kecha arvoh ko‘rganmiz deb o‘ylashdi.

definition_en: An action that breaks a law, rule, or agreement.
example_en: Parking in front of the gate is a clear violation of rules.
example_uz: Darvoza oldida to‘xtash qoidalarning ochiqdan-ochiq buzilishi hisoblanadi.

definition_en: To arrange or prepare a computer system so it works in a specific way.
example_en: You need to configure your email settings before you can send messages.
example_uz: Xabar yuborishdan avval elektron pochta sozlamalarini to‘g‘rilab olishingiz kerak.

definition_en: The condition of being steady and not changing or falling over.
example_en: The economic stability of the country helps businesses grow and expand further.
example_uz: Mamlakatdagi iqtisodiy barqarorlik biznesning rivojlanishi va kengayishiga yordam beradi.

definition_en: The direction between south and west.
example_en: We are planning to visit a small town in the southwest region.
example_uz: Biz janubi-g‘arbiy mintaqadagi kichik bir shaharchaga tashrif buyurishni rejalashtiryapmiz.

definition_en: A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction from your own achievements or qualities.
example_en: She felt a great sense of pride when her son graduated university.
example_uz: O‘g‘li universitetni bitirganida u juda katta faxr tuyg‘usini his qildi.

definition_en: Relating to a large organization or system, such as a school, bank, or government.
example_en: The government needs to address deep-rooted institutional problems in the healthcare sector.
example_uz: Hukumat sog‘liqni saqlash sohasidagi chuqur ildiz otgan tashkiliy muammolarni hal qilishi kerak.

definition_en: The state of being free and not controlled or governed by another country or person.
example_en: Many countries fought for their independence during the twentieth century.
example_uz: Ko‘pgina mamlakatlar yigirmanchi asrda o‘z mustaqilligi uchun kurashdilar.

definition_en: A person who collects information and writes news stories for newspapers, radio, or television.
example_en: The reporter interviewed the politician about the new city development project.
example_uz: Muxbir siyosatchidan yangi shahar rivojlanish loyihasi haqida intervyu oldi.

definition_en: The chemical processes in the body that change food and drink into energy.
example_en: Regular exercise can help to increase your body's metabolism over time.
example_uz: Muntazam mashq qilish vaqt o‘tishi bilan organizm moddalar almashinuvini yaxshilashga yordam beradi.

definition_en: A person or team that has won a competition or sports event.
example_en: He became the world champion after winning the final match last night.
example_uz: Kecha final o‘yinida g‘alaba qozonib, u jahon chempioni bo‘ldi.

definition_en: If the sky is cloudy, it is covered with many clouds.
example_en: It was a cloudy day, so we decided to stay inside home.
example_uz: Havo bulutli bo‘lgani uchun biz uyda qolishga qaror qildik.

definition_en: Used to show that you are giving your own opinion about something.
example_en: I am really annoyed with her, personally, for what she said.
example_uz: U aytgan gaplari uchun shaxsan o'zim undan juda xafaman.

definition_en: A large amount of something, more than enough.
example_en: We are lucky to live in a land of peace and plenty.
example_uz: Tinch va farovon yurtda yashayotganimizdan omadimiz kulgan.

definition_en: Done by one person without any help or other people.
example_en: The pilot successfully completed his first solo flight yesterday morning.
example_uz: Uchuvchi kecha ertalab o'zining ilk mustaqil parvozini muvaffaqiyatli yakunladi.

definition_en: To tell a person who is guilty of a crime what their punishment is.
example_en: The judge sentenced the man to five years in prison today.
example_uz: Sudya bugun erkakni besh yilga ozodlikdan mahrum etishga hukm qildi.

definition_en: To deliberately pay no attention to something or someone.
example_en: He decided to ignore the rude comments made by his neighbor.
example_uz: U qo'shnisining qo'pol gaplarini e'tiborsiz qoldirishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: Large dark flat areas on the surface of the moon.
example_en: Scientists study the maria on the moon to learn about its history.
example_uz: Olimlar oy tarixini o'rganish uchun oy dengizlarini tadqiq qilishadi.

definition_en: The high quality of being very good at something.
example_en: The university is known for excellence in teaching and scientific research.
example_uz: Universitet o'qitish va ilmiy tadqiqotlardagi yuksakligi bilan tanilgan.

definition_en: A large amount of money, property, or valuable things that someone owns.
example_en: He used his family wealth to help those in his community.
example_uz: U o'z oilaviy boyligini mahalladoshlariga yordam berish uchun ishlatdi.

definition_en: Having a greater height than average or than other things.
example_en: The new building is very tall and can be seen from everywhere.
example_uz: Yangi bino juda baland va uni hamma yerdan ko'rish mumkin.

definition_en: In or at an unknown or unspecified place.
example_en: I must have left my keys somewhere in the living room.
example_uz: Men kalitlarimni mehmonxonada qayerdadir qoldirgan bo'lsam kerak.

definition_en: To clean a floor or carpet using a machine that sucks up dust.
example_en: You should vacuum the carpet once a week to keep it clean.
example_uz: Gilamni toza saqlash uchun haftada bir marta changyutkich bilan tozalash kerak.

definition_en: A shiny yellow metal made by mixing copper and zinc.
example_en: The old door handles were made of polished brass.
example_uz: Eski eshik tutqichlari yaltiroq latundan yasalgan edi.

definition_en: A public open space in a city, often surrounded by buildings.
example_en: The tourists sat on a bench in the sunny city plaza.
example_uz: Sayyohlar quyoshli shahar maydonidagi o'rindiqqa o'tirishdi.

definition_en: The state of continuing to live or exist after a difficult situation.
example_en: His survival in the open ocean for three days was a miracle.
example_uz: Uch kun ochiq dengizda omon qolgani chinakam mo‘’jiza bo‘ldi.

definition_en: A long and difficult search for something important or challenging.
example_en: The knight went on a long quest to find the hidden treasure.
example_uz: Ritsar yashirin xazinani topish uchun uzoq va mashaqqatli safarga otlandi.

definition_en: One of the five small parts at the end of your foot.
example_en: I accidentally hit my big toe against the corner of the table.
example_uz: Oyoq bosh barmog‘imni tasodifan stolning burchagiga urib oldim.

definition_en: A very small image that represents a larger picture or page on a computer.
example_en: Click on the thumbnail to see the full version of the photo.
example_uz: Rasmni to‘liq ko‘rish uchun kichik tasvir ustiga bosing.

definition_en: Every time that something happens or is the case.
example_en: Whenever he has a pair of aces, his eyelids twitch.
example_uz: Har gal qo‘lida ikkita tuz bo‘lsa, uning ko‘z qovoqlari pirpiraydi.

definition_en: A star that suddenly becomes much brighter for a short time.
example_en: The astronomer was excited to observe the sudden appearance of a nova.
example_uz: Astronom nova yulduzining to‘satdan paydo bo‘lishini kuzatganidan hayajonlandi.

definition_en: The entire period of time during which a person is alive.
example_en: It is the chance of a lifetime to visit such a place.
example_uz: Bunday joyga tashrif buyurish — bir umrda bir keladigan imkoniyat.

definition_en: Valuable goods or money taken from an enemy in war or by theft.
example_en: The pirates buried their stolen booty on a secret tropical island.
example_uz: Qaroqchilar o‘g‘irlangan o‘ljalarini sirli tropik orolga ko‘mib tashlashdi.

definition_en: Not remembered by someone or no longer in their thoughts.
example_en: He found a forgotten letter hidden in his old desk drawer.
example_uz: U eskirgan stol tortmasida yashiringan unutilgan xatni topib oldi.

definition_en: A person who performs difficult physical acts like jumping and balancing.
example_en: The acrobat performed amazing stunts high above the circus ring.
example_uz: Akrobat sirk maydoni uzra juda balandda ajoyib tryuklarni namoyish etdi.

definition_en: A place where people meet for an organized event like a concert or conference.
example_en: They have finally chosen a large venue for the music festival.
example_uz: Ular nihoyat musiqa festivali uchun katta joy tanlashdi.

definition_en: Having a strong, muscular body or being good at sports.
example_en: He has a very athletic build because he plays tennis every day.
example_uz: U har kuni tennis o'ynagani uchun juda sportchi qomatga ega.

definition_en: Relating to heat or designed to keep you warm by trapping heat.
example_en: You should wear thermal underwear if you go skiing in the mountains.
example_uz: Agar tog'da chang'i uchmoqchi bo'lsangiz, issiqlikni saqlovchi ichki kiyim kiyishingiz kerak.

definition_en: To a moderate degree or amount, but not very.
example_en: The test was fairly difficult, but most students finished it on time.
example_uz: Imtihon ancha qiyin edi, lekin ko'pchilik talabalar uni o'z vaqtida tugatdi.

definition_en: Having the ability to learn, understand, and think in a logical way.
example_en: She is an intelligent student who asks very thoughtful questions in class.
example_uz: U darsda juda o'ylangan savollar beradigan aqlli o'quvchi.

definition_en: A person who is travelling or who often travels to different places.
example_en: The lonely traveler walked across the desert under the hot sun.
example_uz: Yolg'iz sayohatchi jazirama quyosh ostida sahro bo'ylab yurdi.

definition_en: A person who hates or wants to harm another person or group.
example_en: He made a lot of enemies after changing the rules at work.
example_uz: Ishdagi qoidalarni o'zgartirgach, u ko'plab dushman orttirib oldi.

definition_en: A game or problem that is difficult and tests your thinking ability.
example_en: Solving this crossword puzzle is much harder than I first thought.
example_uz: Bu krossvordni yechish o'ylaganimdan ancha qiyinroq ekan.

definition_en: A silver-white metal that is very light and does not rust.
example_en: Many drink cans are made of thin aluminum sheets today.
example_uz: Hozirgi kunda ko'plab ichimlik idishlari yupqa alyuminiydan yasaladi.

definition_en: A list of things that a person would like to have or buy.
example_en: I added the camera to my online wishlist for my next birthday.
example_uz: Men tug'ilgan kunim uchun kamerani onlayn istaklar ro'yxatimga qo'shib qo'ydim.

definition_en: A short written message sent from one mobile phone to another.
example_en: Please send me an sms when you arrive at the train station.
example_uz: Temir yo'l vokzaliga yetib borganingizda menga xabar yuboring.

definition_en: Supporting a system of government where the country is led by elected representatives.
example_en: The politician expressed his strong republican views during the public debate.
example_uz: Siyosatchi ochiq munozara chog'ida o'zining qat'iy respublikachi qarashlarini bayon qildi.

definition_en: The second of two people or things that have just been mentioned.
example_en: We had coffee and cake; the latter was absolutely delicious to eat.
example_uz: Biz kofe va tort ichdik; ikkinchisi juda mazali edi.

definition_en: Having a large distance between two opposite sides or surfaces.
example_en: He wore a thick coat because it was freezing outside today.
example_uz: Tashqarida sovuq bo'lgani uchun u qalin palto kiyib oldi.

definition_en: A group of signs or symptoms that happen together as part of a disease.
example_en: The doctor explained that her symptoms indicate a specific medical syndrome.
example_uz: Shifokor uning alomatlari ma'lum bir tibbiy sindromdan dalolat berishini tushuntirdi.

definition_en: The fact of being present at an event or at a place.
example_en: Attendance at all the university lectures is important for passing the exam.
example_uz: Imtihondan o'tish uchun universitetdagi barcha ma'ruzalarda qatnashish muhimdir.

definition_en: A punishment given for breaking a rule or law.
example_en: The referee gave a penalty because the player touched the ball.
example_uz: Hakam o‘yinchi to‘pga qo‘li bilan tegangani uchun jarima zarbasi belgiladi.

definition_en: A musical instrument that you hit with sticks or your hands to make sound.
example_en: The young boy practiced playing the drums in his room all afternoon.
example_uz: Yosh bola tushdan keyin xonasida baraban chalishni mashq qildi.

definition_en: A person whose job is to build or repair houses and other structures.
example_en: The builder said the new house will be finished by next month.
example_uz: Quruvchi yangi uy kelasi oyga bitishini aytdi.

definition_en: A beautiful view of a large area of countryside or a city.
example_en: From the mountain top, we enjoyed a stunning vista of the valley.
example_uz: Tog‘ cho‘qqisidan vodiyning ajoyib manzarasidan bahramand bo‘ldik.

definition_en: An overflow of a large amount of water onto land that is usually dry.
example_en: The heavy rain caused a major flood in the town center yesterday.
example_uz: Kuchli yomg‘ir shahar markazida katta suv toshqinini keltirib chiqardi.

definition_en: The ability to do something without difficulty or much effort.
example_en: She learned to speak the new language with surprising ease.
example_uz: U yangi tilni hayratlanarli darajada oson o‘rgandi.

definition_en: A large building or flat ground used for sports events, concerts, or shows.
example_en: Thousands of fans gathered at the arena to watch the final match.
example_uz: Minglab muxlislar final o‘yinini tomosha qilish uchun arenaga yig‘ilishdi.

definition_en: A public statement that gives people information about something that has happened or will happen.
example_en: The head of the company made an important announcement during the meeting.
example_uz: Kompaniya rahbari majlis davomida muhim e’lon qildi.

definition_en: To recognize how good or valuable someone or something is.
example_en: I really appreciate all the hard work you did for this project.
example_uz: Ushbu loyiha uchun qilgan barcha mehnatlaringizni chin dildan qadrlayman.

definition_en: Relaxed and informal in style, manner, or relationship.
example_en: Most of the office staff prefers to wear casual clothes on Fridays.
example_uz: Ofis xodimlarining aksariyati juma kunlari norasmiy kiyim kiyishni ma’qul ko‘radi.

definition_en: Having reached the stage of being a full adult.
example_en: I am a grown person and can make my own choices.
example_uz: Men voyaga yetgan insonman va o'z qarorlarimni o'zim qabul qila olaman.

definition_en: To make a surface smooth and shiny by rubbing it.
example_en: He had to polish the wooden table until it was shiny.

definition_en: A document or statement that shows that something is definitely true or arranged.
example_en: We will send you a written confirmation of your hotel booking.
example_uz: Biz sizga mehmonxona bron qilganingiz haqida yozma tasdiqnoma yuboramiz.

definition_en: A small computer program designed to do a specific task on a mobile phone.
example_en: I downloaded a new fitness app to track my daily exercise.
example_uz: Men kundalik mashqlarimni kuzatib borish uchun yangi fitnes ilovasini yuklab oldim.

definition_en: Firmly fixed into the surface of something or deep within something.
example_en: The microchip is embedded deep inside the plastic casing of the device.
example_uz: Mikrochip qurilmaning plastik korpusi ichiga chuqur o‘rnatilgan.

definition_en: A type of printer that prints by spraying tiny drops of ink onto paper.
example_en: Inkjets are very common for printing high-quality color photos at home.
example_uz: Struyli printerlar uy sharoitida sifatli rangli fotosuratlarni chiqarish uchun juda qulay.

definition_en: A person in charge of a group of workers or a specific task.
example_en: You should discuss any problems with your supervisor before taking action.
example_uz: Biror ish qilishdan oldin muammolaringizni boshlig‘ingiz bilan muhokama qilishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A person who is extremely good or talented at doing a specific complex thing.
example_en: He is a computer wizard who can fix any technical problem instantly.
example_uz: U har qanday texnik muammoni darhol hal qila oladigan kompyuter ustasi.

definition_en: An organized group of people who share a specific job or purpose.
example_en: The diplomatic corps was invited to the president's annual winter reception.
example_uz: Diplomatik korpus prezidentning yillik qishki qabuliga taklif qilindi.

definition_en: A large organ in the body that cleans the blood and helps process food.
example_en: Eating too much fat can be harmful to your liver health.
example_uz: Juda ko'p yog'li ovqat iste'mol qilish jigaringizga zarar yetkazishi mumkin.

definition_en: External equipment that connects to a computer, such as a mouse or printer.
example_en: I need to buy some new peripherals like a keyboard and mouse.
example_uz: Menga sichqoncha va klaviatura kabi yangi tashqi qurilmalar sotib olish kerak.

definition_en: A small book or folded paper with information about a product or service.
example_en: Please pick up a travel brochure from the tourist information desk.
example_uz: Iltimos, sayyohlik axborot markazidan sayohat bukletini olib keling.

definition_en: To bring a fact or event back into your mind to remember it.
example_en: I cannot recall his name even though we met last year.
example_uz: O'tgan yili ko'rishgan bo'lsak-da, uning ismini eslay olmayapman.

definition_en: A device used to send or receive radio or television signals.
example_en: We need to fix the antenna to get a better television signal.
example_uz: Televizor yaxshi ko'rsatishi uchun antennani tuzatib qo'yishimiz kerak.

definition_en: The act of leaving a place, especially to start a journey.
example_en: Our departure from the airport was delayed due to heavy snowfall.
example_uz: Kuchli qor yog'ishi tufayli aeroportdan jo'nab ketishimiz kechikdi.

definition_en: A feeling that something is true or exists, even without proof.
example_en: It is my firm belief that honesty is the best policy.
example_uz: Rostgo'ylik eng yaxshi yo'l ekanligiga qat'iy ishonaman.

definition_en: A women's two-piece swimsuit for swimming or sunbathing.
example_en: She bought a new colorful bikini for her beach holiday trip.
example_uz: U plyajdagi ta'tili uchun yangi rang-barang bikini sotib oldi.

definition_en: The style and arrangement of furniture and objects in a room.
example_en: The minimalist decor of the living room makes it feel very spacious.
example_uz: Mehmonxonaning minimalistik uslubdagi bezagi uni juda keng ko'rsatadi.

definition_en: The act of searching for information in a book or database.
example_en: This database lookup helps us find customer details very quickly.
example_uz: Ushbu ma'lumotlar bazasini qidirish bizga mijozlar haqidagi ma'lumotlarni tez topishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: An atom or group of atoms that has an electrical charge.
example_en: The salt dissolves into sodium and chloride ions in the water.
example_uz: Tuz suvda natriy va xlorid ionlariga parchalanadi.

definition_en: A straight line measuring the width of a circle through its center.
example_en: The circle has a diameter of exactly ten centimeters across.
example_uz: Bu aylananing diametri aniq o‘n santimetrga teng.

definition_en: A toy that looks like a small person or baby.
example_en: The little girl is playing with her favorite plastic doll.
example_uz: Kichkina qizaloq o‘zining sevimli qo‘g‘irchog‘i bilan o‘ynayapti.

definition_en: A person who offers a specific price for something during an auction.
example_en: The highest bidder at the auction will win the painting.
example_uz: Auksionda eng yuqori narx taklif qilgan xaridor rasmga ega bo‘ladi.

definition_en: A person who sings songs, especially as their job or hobby.
example_en: The famous singer performed a beautiful song at the concert last night.
example_uz: Mashhur xonanda kechagi konsertda juda goʻzal qoʻshiq kuyladi.

definition_en: To be a sign that something is about to happen.
example_en: These heavy rain clouds herald the arrival of a long storm.
example_uz: Bu qora bulutlar uzoq davom etadigan boʻron yaqinlashayotganidan darak beradi.

definition_en: The natural process of becoming older over time.
example_en: Proper nutrition and exercise can help slow down the aging process.
example_uz: Toʻgʻri ovqatlanish va jismoniy mashqlar qarish jarayonini sekinlashtirishga yordam beradi.

definition_en: The act of getting involved in a situation to change what is happening.
example_en: The government's intervention was necessary to stop the economic crisis.
example_uz: Iqtisodiy inqirozni toʻxtatish uchun hukumatning aralashuvi zarur edi.

definition_en: A small software program that adds a new feature to a larger application.
example_en: You need to install this plugin to watch videos on the website.
example_uz: Veb-saytda video koʻrish uchun ushbu plagini oʻrnatishingiz kerak.

definition_en: The sport or activity of jumping into water or swimming underwater.
example_en: We went scuba diving to see the colorful fish under the sea.
example_uz: Dengiz ostidagi rang-barang baliqlarni koʻrish uchun shoʻngʻishga bordik.

definition_en: The act of making small changes to something to improve it.
example_en: We made a small modification to the plan to save some time.
example_uz: Vaqtni tejash uchun rejaga kichik o'zgartirish kiritdik.

definition_en: To believe something is probably true, even if you are not certain.
example_en: I suppose we all agree that this is the best solution.
example_uz: Menimcha, hammamiz bu eng yaxshi yechim ekanligiga rozi bo'lamiz.

definition_en: A tall plant that grows in groups near water with hollow stems.
example_en: Tall reeds were swaying slowly in the wind by the river.
example_uz: Daryo bo'yidagi baland qamishlar shamolda sekin tebranardi.

definition_en: Neither very great nor very small in amount, intensity, or quality.
example_en: The hotel offers a high level of comfort at a moderate price.
example_uz: Mehmonxona o'rtacha narx evaziga yuqori darajadagi qulaylikni taqdim etadi.

definition_en: A feeling of extreme fear or worry about something very bad.
example_en: The children were filled with terror when the storm started suddenly.
example_uz: To'satdan bo'ron boshlanganda bolalar dahshatga tushishdi.

definition_en: Used to describe someone who is not as old as another person.
example_en: My younger brother is still going to primary school right now.
example_uz: Mening ukam hali ham boshlang'ich maktabga boradi.

definition_en: The number that is one more than twenty-nine.
example_en: We have thirty students in our class for this english lesson.
example_uz: Bizning ingliz tili darsimizda o'ttiz nafar o'quvchi bor.

definition_en: Small furry animals with long tails, plural of mouse.
example_en: The cat was hunting for mice in the old house.
example_uz: Mushuk eski uyda sichqonlarni ovlayotgan edi.

definition_en: Located directly across from something else, or facing in another direction.
example_en: She saw him walking on the opposite side of the road.
example_uz: U yigitni yo‘lning qarama-qarshi tomonida ketayotganini ko‘rib qoldi.

definition_en: To know the meaning of something that someone has said or written.
example_en: He finally understood what the teacher was trying to explain.
example_uz: U oxiri o‘qituvchi nima demoqchi bo‘lganini tushunib yetdi.

definition_en: Happening or done in a very short time.
example_en: Technology is changing so rapidly that it is hard to keep up.
example_uz: Texnologiya shunchalik tez rivojlanyaptiki, unga yetib olish qiyin.

definition_en: To say officially that something is not allowed.
example_en: The government decided to ban smoking in all public places.
example_uz: Hukumat barcha jamoat joylarida chekishni taqiqlashga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A person employed to work for a short period of time.
example_en: We hired a temp to help us during the busy summer season.
example_uz: Biz yozgi gavjum mavsumda yordam berishi uchun vaqtincha ishchi yolladik.

definition_en: A short beginning part of a song, film, or presentation.
example_en: The video has a cool intro that grabs your attention immediately.
example_uz: Videoning darhol diqqatingni tortadigan ajoyib kirish qismi bor.

definition_en: A statement made to someone to make them feel confident or certain about something.
example_en: He gave me his assurance that the work would be finished today.
example_uz: U ishning bugun bitishiga menga kafolat berdi.

definition_en: A person who works in an office dealing with records, letters, and administrative tasks.
example_en: The office clerk filed all the important documents in the cabinet.
example_uz: Ofis kotibi barcha muhim hujjatlarni shkafga joylab qo'ydi.

definition_en: A brief summary that gives the main points of a plan or document.
example_en: The professor provided an outline of the course at the beginning.
example_uz: Professor dars boshida kursning qisqacha rejasini taqdim etdi.

definition_en: A strong medicine used to reduce moderate to severe pain in the body.
example_en: The doctor prescribed tramadol to help manage the patient's severe back pain.
example_uz: Shifokor bemorning kuchli bel og'rig'ini qoldirish uchun tramadol yozib berdi.

definition_en: The act of gathering information from different places to create a single work.
example_en: The book is a compilation of articles written by various famous experts.
example_uz: Kitob turli mashhur mutaxassislar tomonidan yozilgan maqolalar to'plamidir.

definition_en: The process of proving that something is true or accurate.
example_en: The detective needs verification of your whereabouts last night.
example_uz: Detektivga o‘tgan kecha qayerda bo‘lganingizni tasdiqlovchi dalil kerak.

definition_en: Different from what is usual or expected; not normal.
example_en: She slept in, which was very odd for her routine.
example_uz: U uxlab qoldi, bu uning tartibi uchun juda g‘alati edi.

definition_en: To cover something completely by folding a material around it.
example_en: Christmas gifts are commonly known to be wrapped in paper.
example_uz: Rojdestvo sovg‘alari odatda qog‘ozga o‘raladi.

definition_en: The way you feel at a particular time.
example_en: I've been in a bad mood since I was dumped.
example_uz: Tashlab ketilishimdan beri kayfiyatim yo‘q.

definition_en: A kind or helpful act that you do for someone.
example_en: He did me a favor when he took me home.
example_uz: U meni uyga tashlab qo‘yib, menga yaxshilik qildi.

definition_en: Pleasing or appealing to the senses or mind.
example_en: She looks very attractive in her new blue dress today.
example_uz: U yangi ko‘k ko‘ylagida juda jozibali ko‘rinadi.

definition_en: A special event or a particular time when something happens.
example_en: We met on several occasions during the summer holiday.
example_uz: Biz yozgi ta'til davomida bir necha bor uchrashdik.

definition_en: A person who has been harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime.
example_en: The police questioned the victim about the robbery last night.
example_uz: Politsiya kecha sodir bo‘lgan o‘g‘rilik yuzasidan jabrlanuvchini so‘roq qildi.

definition_en: Giving a lot of attention to what you are doing to avoid mistakes or harm.
example_en: Please be careful when you cross this busy road.
example_uz: Iltimos, bu gavjum yo‘lni kesib o‘tayotganda ehtiyot bo‘ling.

definition_en: A long, thick piece of wood or metal used to support a building structure.
example_en: The wooden beam in the ceiling supports the weight of the roof.
example_uz: Shiftga o'rnatilgan yog'och to'sin tomni ko'tarib turibdi.

definition_en: A large group of musicians who play many different instruments together.
example_en: The symphony orchestra performed a beautiful piece of classical music last night.
example_uz: Simfonik orkestr kecha klassik musiqadan ajoyib asar ijro etdi.

definition_en: The time of day when the sun goes down below the horizon.
example_en: We sat on the beach and watched the beautiful orange sunset.
example_uz: Biz sohilga o'tirib, quyosh botishining go'zal manzarasini tomosha qildik.

definition_en: Used to add another important piece of information to what you just said.
example_en: The house is beautiful; moreover, it is in a great location.
example_uz: Uy juda chiroyli, qolaversa, u juda yaxshi joyda joylashgan.

definition_en: Music that has two or more independent melodies played at the same time.
example_en: The choir sang a complex polyphonic piece during the church service.
example_uz: Xor cherkov ibodati vaqtida murakkab ko'p ovozli asar kuyladi.

definition_en: A game where people buy numbered tickets to try to win money prizes.
example_en: He bought a lottery ticket hoping to win the massive jackpot prize.
example_uz: U katta yutuqni qo'lga kiritish umidida lotereya chiptasini sotib oldi.

definition_en: To or on one side so as to be out of the way.
example_en: Please step aside so the people can walk through the hallway.
example_uz: Iltimos, odamlar yo'lakdan o'tib olishi uchun chetroqqa turing.

definition_en: An official document that gives you permission to own or do something.
example_en: You need a valid driving licence to operate a car legally.
example_uz: Avtomobilni qonuniy boshqarish uchun sizda haydovchilik guvohnomasi bo'lishi kerak.

definition_en: Able to be changed or moved to suit a specific need or size.
example_en: You can change the height of this adjustable office chair easily.
example_uz: Bu sozlanadigan ish stulining balandligini osonlikcha o'zgartirishingiz mumkin.

definition_en: The act of giving a specific amount of money or resources for a purpose.
example_en: The government announced a new budget allocation for public school improvements.
example_uz: Hukumat umumta'lim maktablarini yaxshilash uchun yangi byudjet ajratmasini e'lon qildi.

definition_en: A short piece of writing on a particular subject, usually by a student.
example_en: I need to write a long essay about history for my class.
example_uz: Men darsim uchun tarix haqida uzun insho yozishim kerak.

definition_en: A conversation between two or more people in a book, play, or film.
example_en: The actors performed the dialogue with a lot of emotion and skill.
example_uz: Aktyorlar dialogni juda ko'p hissiyot va mahorat bilan ijro etishdi.

definition_en: Arranged in the order of the letters of the alphabet.
example_en: Please keep all the files in alphabetical order for easier access.
example_uz: Oson topish uchun barcha fayllarni alifbo tartibida saqlang.

definition_en: To have sent someone or something to a destination for a particular purpose.
example_en: The manager dispatched a team to solve the problem at the office.
example_uz: Menejer ofisdagi muammoni hal qilish uchun jamoani yubordi.

definition_en: Small enough to be held and used easily in one or both hands.
example_en: She carries a small handheld device to check the warehouse inventory.
example_uz: U ombordagi mollarni tekshirish uchun qo'lda ishlatiladigan kichik qurilmadan foydalanadi.

definition_en: A small mark or sign that shows someone or something was present there.
example_en: Police found no trace of the missing person in the forest.
example_uz: Politsiya o'rmonda g'oyib bo'lgan odamdan hech qanday iz topa olmadi.

definition_en: The act of getting rid of something that is no longer wanted or needed.
example_en: The correct disposal of dangerous chemicals is very important for our environment.
example_uz: Xavfli kimyoviy moddalarni to'g'ri yo'q qilish atrof-muhitimiz uchun juda muhimdir.

definition_en: To move something into a position so that an opening is covered.
example_en: Please shut the window because it is cold outside today.
example_uz: Iltimos, derazani yopib qo'y, chunki tashqarida sovuq.

definition_en: The highest university degree that can be earned in a specific field of study.
example_en: She is working hard to complete her PhD in history this year.
example_uz: U bu yil tarix bo'yicha doktorlik dissertatsiyasini tugatish ustida qattiq ishlamoqda.

definition_en: By a very large amount or to a high degree.
example_en: The quality of life has greatly improved in our town recently.
example_uz: Keyingi paytlarda shahrimizda hayot sifati sezilarli darajada yaxshilandi.

definition_en: The activity of regularly writing and posting content on a personal website or blog.
example_en: She enjoys blogging about her travels to different countries around the world.
example_uz: U dunyo bo'ylab sayohatlari haqida blog yuritishni yaxshi ko'radi.

definition_en: A cover for the face to protect it or hide who you are.
example_en: Everyone had to wear a protective mask inside the crowded hospital building.
example_uz: Gavjum shifoxona binosida hamma himoya niqobini taqib yurishi kerak edi.

definition_en: Happening often or seen by many people in most situations.
example_en: This plant is commonly found in tropical forests near the equator.
example_uz: Bu o'simlik ekvator yaqinidagi tropik o'rmonlarda ko'p uchraydi.

definition_en: A person who takes photographs as a hobby or as their job.
example_en: The professional photographer took some beautiful pictures of the wedding guests today.
example_uz: Professional fotosuratchi bugun to'y mehmonlarining juda chiroyli suratlarini oldi.

definition_en: To tell someone about something or give them important facts.
example_en: Please inform the office if you cannot attend the meeting tomorrow.
example_uz: Agar ertangi majlisga kela olmasangiz, iltimos, idoraga xabar bering.

definition_en: Relating to Turkey, its people, or its official language.
example_en: We had a delicious lunch at a traditional Turkish restaurant downtown yesterday.
example_uz: Kecha shahardagi an'anaviy turk restoranida juda mazali tushlik qildik.

definition_en: A black rock mined from the ground and burned to produce heat or power.
example_en: In the past many homes were heated using coal during the winter.
example_uz: Ilgari ko'plab uylar qishda ko'mir yoqib isitilgan.

definition_en: The smallest possible and indivisible unit of energy or a physical phenomenon.
example_en: The discovery of the quantum changed our entire understanding of modern physics.
example_uz: Kvantning kashf etilishi zamonaviy fizika haqidagi barcha tushunchamizni o'zgartirib yubordi.

definition_en: The purpose or the plan that someone has for doing something.
example_en: She went to the meeting with the clear intent of resigning today.
example_uz: U yig'ilishga bugun iste'foga chiqish niyati bilan bordi.

definition_en: For the most part; mainly or chiefly.
example_en: The project was largely successful thanks to the team's hard work.
example_uz: Jamoaning mehnatkashligi tufayli loyiha asosan muvaffaqiyatli yakunlandi.

definition_en: Enjoyable, attractive, or friendly.
example_en: We had a very pleasant walk around the park this afternoon.
example_uz: Bugun tushdan keyin bog'da juda yoqimli sayr qildik.

definition_en: Built or created by people rather than occurring naturally.
example_en: The bridge was constructed using advanced technology to ensure it stays strong.
example_uz: Ko'prik uzoq vaqt mustahkam turishi uchun zamonaviy texnologiyalar yordamida qurilgan.

definition_en: The past simple form of speak; to have said something using your voice.
example_en: She spoke to the teacher about her grades after the lesson ended.
example_uz: Dars tugagandan so'ng u o'qituvchi bilan baholari haqida gaplashdi.

definition_en: A thin object with a sharp point, often used as a sign for direction.
example_en: Follow the arrow on the wall to find the way to exit.
example_uz: Chiqish yo'lini topish uchun devordagi strelka bo'ylab yuring.

definition_en: An arrangement to meet someone or do something at a specific time.
example_en: He had a business engagement and could not attend the party tonight.
example_uz: Uning ish bo'yicha uchrashuvi bor edi va bugun kechqurungi bazmga bora olmadi.

definition_en: Having a surface that is not smooth, even, or soft to the touch.
example_en: The cat had rough skin on its tongue when it licked me.
example_uz: Mushuk meni yalaganda uning tili dag'al ekanligini sezdim.

definition_en: Very strange or unusual in a way that is difficult to explain.
example_en: It is weird how he always wears a coat on hot days.
example_uz: Issiq kunlarda ham doim palto kiyib yurishi juda g'alati.

definition_en: A casual short-sleeved shirt, often made of cotton, worn in warm weather.
example_en: I bought a comfortable cotton tee to wear during the summer holiday.
example_uz: Yozgi ta'tilda kiyish uchun qulay paxtali futbolka sotib oldim.

definition_en: To get a new loan with better terms to pay off an existing one.
example_en: They decided to refinance their mortgage to get a lower interest rate.
example_uz: Ular foiz stavkasini pasaytirish uchun ipoteka kreditini qayta moliyalashtirishga qaror qilishdi.

definition_en: Feeling excited and wanting to do something creative or good.
example_en: The artist was inspired by the beautiful sunset to paint a picture.
example_uz: Rassom go'zal quyosh botishini ko'rib, rasm chizishga ilhomlandi.

definition_en: The sharp flat metal part of a tool or weapon used for cutting.
example_en: Make sure the knife blade is sharp before you start cutting meat.
example_uz: Go'sht kesishdan oldin pichoqning tig'i o'tkirligiga ishonch hosil qiling.

definition_en: Happening very quickly and without any warning.
example_en: Suddenly, it started to rain while we were walking in the park.
example_uz: Bog'da sayr qilib yurganimizda to'satdan yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

definition_en: A gas in the air that all people and animals need to breathe.
example_en: Plants produce oxygen which is necessary for human life on Earth.
example_uz: O'simliklar Yer yuzidagi inson hayoti uchun zarur bo'lgan kislorodni ishlab chiqaradi.

definition_en: A small sweet baked food that is usually round and flat.
example_en: Would you like to have a cookie with your cup of tea?
example_uz: Choyingiz bilan bitta pechenye yeysizmi?

definition_en: A very deep valley with steep sides, often with a river running through.
example_en: We traveled to the grand canyon to see the impressive rock formations.
example_uz: Biz hayratlanarli qoyalarni ko'rish uchun katta kanyonga bordik.

definition_en: Used to emphasize that something is not more than what you are saying.
example_en: He was merely trying to help when he offered his honest advice.
example_uz: U samimiy maslahat berib, shunchaki yordam bermoqchi edi.

definition_en: A plan or agreement made with someone to do something in the future.
example_en: We made an arrangement to meet at the station at ten o'clock.
example_uz: Biz soat o'nda vokzalda uchrashishga kelishib oldik.

definition_en: A list of books and articles that were used when writing a specific paper.
example_en: You must include a bibliography at the end of your research essay.
example_uz: Ilmiy inshongiz oxirida foydalanilgan adabiyotlar ro'yxati bo'lishi shart.

definition_en: A small piece of helpful advice or a useful tip.
example_en: The teacher gave me some helpful pointers on how to study better.
example_uz: O'qituvchi menga yaxshiroq o'qish bo'yicha foydali maslahatlar berdi.

definition_en: The ability of two or more things to exist or work together without problems.
example_en: There are some compatibility issues between the old software and the computer.
example_uz: Eski dasturiy ta'minot va kompyuter o'rtasida moslik bilan bog'liq muammolar bor.

definition_en: To make something longer or wider by pulling it.
example_en: You should stretch your muscles before you start running in the morning.
example_uz: Ertalab yugurishni boshlashdan oldin mushaklaringizni cho'zishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Used to add more information to what you have just said.
example_en: The house is very large; furthermore, it is in a great location.
example_uz: Bu uy juda katta, qolaversa, joylashuvi ham juda qulay.

definition_en: Willing to help or do what is asked.
example_en: We need to be cooperative if we want to finish this task.
example_uz: Agar bu ishni tugatmoqchi bo'lsak, hamkorlikda ishlashimiz kerak.

definition_en: The part of a piece of clothing that covers your arm.
example_en: My shirt has a long sleeve that I can fold up easily.
example_uz: Ko‘ylagimning yengi uzun, uni osonlikcha qayirib qo‘yishim mumkin.

definition_en: A person whose job is to keep rooms or offices tidy and clean.
example_en: The cleaner comes to our office every morning to tidy up.
example_uz: Farrosh har kuni ertalab ofisimizni tartibga keltirish uchun keladi.

definition_en: A team sport played with a ball and wooden bats on grass.
example_en: Many people in England enjoy watching a game of cricket together.
example_uz: Angliyadagi ko‘plab insonlar kriket o‘yinini tomosha qilishdan zavqlanishadi.

definition_en: The meat from a cow, often eaten as food.
example_en: We had some delicious roasted beef for our Sunday family dinner.
example_uz: Yakshanba kungi oilaviy kechki ovqatimiz uchun mazali mol go‘shtidan taom tayyorladik.

definition_en: A serious medical condition where blood stops flowing to part of the brain.
example_en: The old man was rushed to hospital after suffering a sudden stroke.
example_uz: Qariya to‘satdan insult bo‘lganidan so‘ng shoshilinch ravishda shifoxonaga olib ketildi.

definition_en: A small town or a specific area of a town used as a district.
example_en: They moved to a small township located just outside the large city.
example_uz: Ular katta shahardan uncha uzoq bo‘lmagan kichik shaharchaga ko‘chib o‘tishdi.

definition_en: A list of people or things ordered by their quality or level of success.
example_en: The university reached the top of the global rankings this year.
example_uz: Bu yil universitet jahon reytinglarida eng yuqori o‘rinni egalladi.

definition_en: A small bird with a red chest that is often seen in gardens.
example_en: I saw a robin singing on the tree in our back garden.
example_uz: Bog'imizdagi daraxtda sayrayotgan qizilishtonni ko'rib qoldim.

definition_en: A narrow strip of material used to hold, fasten, or carry something.
example_en: The strap of my watch broke while I was walking home.
example_uz: Uyga qaytayotganimda soatimning tasmasi uzilib ketdi.

definition_en: The main office or building where a company or organization is controlled.
example_en: The company has its international headquarters in the city center.
example_uz: Kompaniyaning xalqaro bosh qarorgohi shahar markazida joylashgan.

definition_en: To ride on a wave in the sea using a special board.
example_en: He loves to go surf at the beach during his summer holidays.
example_uz: U yozgi ta'til paytida plyajda syorfing qilishni juda yoqtiradi.

definition_en: Relating to the Olympic Games, a major international sports competition held every four years.
example_en: The Olympic athletes trained for years to win a gold medal.
example_uz: Olimpiya o‘yinlari sportchilari oltin medalni yutish uchun yillar davomida shug‘ullandilar.

definition_en: A complete and often positive change in the appearance or character of someone or something.
example_en: The city underwent a radical transformation over the last ten years.
example_uz: So‘nggi o‘n yil ichida shahar tubdan o‘zgarib ketdi.

definition_en: Things that exist as distinct and independent units or organizations.
example_en: These two companies are separate legal entities under the current law.
example_uz: Bu ikki kompaniya amaldagi qonunchilikka ko‘ra alohida yuridik shaxslar hisoblanadi.

definition_en: A colorful arch in the sky made by sunlight shining through rain.
example_en: We saw a beautiful rainbow in the sky after the rain.
example_uz: Yomg‘irdan keyin osmonda chiroyli kamalakni ko‘rdik.

definition_en: A curved piece of metal or plastic used for catching or hanging things.
example_en: Please hang your heavy winter coat on the hook by the door.
example_uz: Iltimos, qishki paltoni eshik yonidagi ilgakka osib qo‘ying.

definition_en: A gambling game where a ball is rolled onto a spinning wheel with numbered sections.
example_en: He lost all his money playing roulette at the casino last night.
example_uz: U kecha kazinoda ruletka o‘ynab bor pullarini yutqazib qo‘ydi.

definition_en: Relating to the country of Israel or its people.
example_en: The Israeli government decided to increase funding for public schools.
example_uz: Isroil hukumati davlat maktablarini moliyalashtirishni oshirishga qaror qildi.

definition_en: A person who pays regularly to receive a service or a publication.
example_en: Our magazine has over ten thousand subscribers around the whole world.
example_uz: Jurnalimizning butun dunyo bo‘ylab o‘n mingdan ortiq obunachisi bor.

definition_en: A part of a machine or organ that opens to control the flow of liquid.
example_en: You need to turn the valve to stop the water from flowing out.
example_uz: Suv oqib ketmasligi uchun klapanni burab qo‘yishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A tool with a sharp metal blade used for cutting food or other things.
example_en: He was looking for a sharp knife to chop some fresh steak.
example_uz: U yangi mol go‘shtini to‘g‘rash uchun o‘tkir pichoq qidirayotgan edi.

definition_en: A tropical plant with red flowers used to make a refreshing sour drink.
example_en: I drank a cold glass of jamaica on a hot summer day.
example_uz: Issiq yoz kunida muzdek guldorrayhon sharbatini ichdim.

definition_en: Things that you think are more important than other things.
example_en: You should list your daily tasks based on your highest priorities.
example_uz: Kundalik ishlaringizni eng muhim vazifalaringizga qarab belgilab olishingiz kerak.

definition_en: A shop where you can buy books.
example_en: I went to the bookstore to buy a new English novel.
example_uz: Yangi inglizcha roman sotib olish uchun kitob do'koniga bordim.

definition_en: To legally take someone else's child into your family to care for them.
example_en: They decided to adopt a baby after many years of marriage.
example_uz: Ular ko'p yillik turmushdan so'ng chaqaloq asrab olishga qaror qilishdi.

definition_en: To say that something is not true or did not happen.
example_en: The suspect denied everything when the police asked him about the crime.
example_uz: Politsiya jinoyat haqida so'raganda, gumondor hamma narsani inkor qildi.

definition_en: Extremely good, impressive, or difficult to believe.
example_en: The view from the top of the mountain was truly incredible.
example_uz: Tog' cho'qqisidan ko'rinadigan manzara shunchaki ajoyib edi.

definition_en: Computer software that you can download and use for free.
example_en: This application is freeware, so you do not need to pay anything.
example_uz: Bu dastur bepul, shuning uchun hech narsa to'lashingiz shart emas.

definition_en: Money or goods that you give to help an organization or a charity.
example_en: They were collecting donations for the elderly at Christmas time this year.
example_uz: Ular Rojdestvo arafasida qariyalar uchun xayriya yigʻishayotgan edi.

definition_en: Located on the outside of something.
example_en: You should wear an outer layer to stay warm in the cold.
example_uz: Sovuqda issiq yurish uchun ustingizdan qalin kiyim kiyib olishingiz kerak.

definition_en: Plants grown by a farmer, such as wheat or vegetables, to eat or sell.
example_en: The farmer expects a very good crop of wheat this coming autumn.
example_uz: Dehqon bu kuzda bugʻdoydan juda yaxshi hosil olishni kutmoqda.

definition_en: Stories about imaginary events or people, often for children.
example_en: My grandmother told us many wonderful tales when we were small children.
example_uz: Biz yosh bolaligimizda buvim bizga juda koʻp ajoyib ertaklar aytib berardi.

definition_en: The short, thick finger on the side of your hand.
example_en: He gave us a thumbs up to show everything was fine.
example_uz: Hammasi joyidaligini ko'rsatish uchun u bosh barmog'ini ko'tardi.

definition_en: Small hard parts of a plant from which a new plant can grow.
example_en: I am planning to plant some sunflower seeds in the garden.
example_uz: Bog'ga kungaboqar urug'larini ekmoqchiman.

definition_en: A simple version of a product or food with less fat or calories.
example_en: Most users prefer the lite version because it is much faster.
example_uz: Ko'pchilik foydalanuvchilar yengil versiyasini afzal ko'rishadi, chunki u tezroq ishlaydi.

definition_en: Relating to the way something is arranged or organized.
example_en: She has excellent organizational skills and manages her time very well.
example_uz: U juda yaxshi tashkiliy qobiliyatlarga ega va vaqtini to'g'ri boshqaradi.

definition_en: To call or message someone using the internet software called Skype.
example_en: We can skype tomorrow morning to discuss the details of the project.
example_uz: Loyiha tafsilotlarini muhokama qilish uchun ertaga ertalab Skype orqali gaplashamiz.

definition_en: The number that comes after eleven and before thirteen.
example_en: There are twelve months in a year and twelve hours on clocks.
example_uz: Bir yilda o'n ikki oy va soatda o'n ikki soat bor.

definition_en: A person who starts a new company, organization, or institution.
example_en: The founder of the company is planning to step down next month.
example_uz: Kompaniya asoschisi kelasi oy lavozimidan ketishni rejalashtirmoqda.

definition_en: A serious disagreement or argument between people or groups.
example_en: The two neighbors were involved in a long dispute over the fence.
example_uz: Ikki qo'shni panjara ustida uzoq vaqt tortishib qoldi.

definition_en: In or to all places or locations.
example_en: I looked for my keys everywhere but could not find them.
example_uz: Kalitlarimni hamma joydan qidirdim lekin topa olmadim.

definition_en: A short piece of writing, music, or film taken from a larger work.
example_en: The newspaper published an excerpt from the author's new book.
example_uz: Gazeta yozuvchining yangi kitobidan bir parcha chop etdi.

definition_en: The hot gas that is created when water is boiled.
example_en: Hot steam rose from the pot of boiling water.
example_uz: Qaynayotgan suv solingan idishdan issiq bug' chiqayotgan edi.

definition_en: To finish or complete an official duty or an obligation.
example_en: The new manager will discharge his duties with a focus on teamwork.
example_uz: Yangi menejer o‘z vazifalarini jamoaviy ishlashga e’tibor qaratib bajaradi.

definition_en: To complete a test or task perfectly or very successfully.
example_en: I studied all night because I really wanted to ace the exam.
example_uz: Men butun kecha o‘qidim chunki imtihonni a’lo darajada topshirmoqchi edim.

definition_en: A holiday celebrated on October 31st with costumes and scary themes.
example_en: Children wear scary costumes when they go trick-or-treating on Halloween.
example_uz: Bolalar Hellouinda qo‘rqinchli liboslar kiyib shirinlik yig‘ishga chiqishadi.

definition_en: The activity of moving upwards on a mountain or a wall.
example_en: Rock climbing is a popular sport for people who enjoy adventure.
example_uz: Qoyaga tirmashish sarguzashtni yaxshi ko‘radigan odamlar uchun ommabop sport turidir.

definition_en: The past tense of stand, meaning to be in an upright position.
example_en: He stood at the bus stop and waited for his friend.
example_uz: U avtobus bekatida tik turib do‘stini kutdi.

definition_en: A liquid with a pleasant smell that people put on their skin.
example_en: She sprayed a little perfume on her wrist before leaving home.
example_uz: U uydan chiqishdan oldin bilagiga ozgina atir sepdi.

definition_en: A traditional song that people sing during the Christmas season.
example_en: The choir sang a beautiful Christmas carol at the church event.
example_uz: Xor cherkov marosimida chiroyli bayram qo‘shig‘ini kuyladi.

definition_en: The capital city of the state of New York in the USA.
example_en: Many politicians work in the state capital of Albany.
example_uz: Ko‘plab siyosatchilar shtat poytaxti Albanida ishlashadi.

definition_en: Involving risk or danger to safety or health.
example_en: Working with chemicals in this factory can be very hazardous indeed.
example_uz: Zavodda kimyoviy moddalar bilan ishlash juda xavfli bo‘lishi mumkin.

definition_en: To arrange objects on top of each other in an orderly way.
example_en: Please stack those empty chairs neatly in the corner of the room.
example_uz: Iltimos, o‘sha bo‘sh stullarni xona burchagiga tartib bilan taxlab qo‘ying.

definition_en: An unspecified or unknown person.
example_en: Somebody left their umbrella on the bus this morning by mistake.
example_uz: Bugun ertalab kimdir adashib soyabonini avtobusda unutib qoldiribdi.

definition_en: To take legal action against someone in a civil court.
example_en: The company decided to sue the contractor for failing to finish work.
example_uz: Kompaniya ishni oxiriga yetkazmagani uchun pudratchini sudga berishga qaror qildi.
